sentiment.rationale: This pre-earnings digest describes depressed expectations heading into the Q3 2024 print: consensus revenue growth of just 1.4% YoY, 9 downward revenue-estimate revisions over the prior 30 days, and prior misses in two of the prior several quarters. The market has already priced in continued deceleration, framing the key question as whether PepsiCo could stabilize (not reaccelerate) its growth trajectory. This low bar raises the odds of a positive surprise reaction even on modest results, supporting a mildly bullish score.
